Elena (People Ops): Quick kickoff: 2026 attestation window opens tomorrow 09:00 PT. Please complete the 15-min privacy microtraining and either upload one SOC2-relevant artifact or file a ticket with an evidence owner by the close.
Elena (People Ops): Deadline: 2026-08-14 17:00 PT. Checklist + upload: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations (folder: 2026).
Marta (Eng): What counts as an artifact? runbooks, IAM export ok?
Raj (Security): Yes. Examples: runbook/playbook (PDF/MD), IAM export CSV, backup manifest, KMS rotation export, or a ticket assigning an evidence owner with ETA.
Owen (SRE): We have a maintenance window during the window. Can we request an extension?
Elena (People Ops): We allow scoped extensions up to 72h for release conflicts. Create ticket "Compliance extension - <team> - <reason>" and cc @Raj. Training still due on time.
Docs Bot: Microtraining assigned: "Privacy Refresher 2026"  link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026
Compliance Bot: Automated reminders scheduled 72h/48h/24h before deadline; teams with missing items will receive DMs and an @here ping in #people-ops.
Marta (Eng): I'll upload runbook + IAM CSV to /attestations/2026/eng/ today.
Elena (People Ops): Perfect  if anyone's unsure, open a ticket titled "TEAM - Attestation 2026 - owner: <name>" and mark evidence: pending with an ETA. Auditors accept that as interim evidence. We'll post a final 6h reminder.
